result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred insurance position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber at USD 5M covering IBM’s processing of Customer Data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It leaves the existing risk-of-loss allocation unchanged. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after termination goes beyond the playbook and is not narrowly tailored, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation. Drafting is generally professional, but the insurance provision should be separately numbered, use the defined term “Customer Data” consistently, and limit any post-termination requirement to applicable claims-made coverage, if intended.
